messages:
zoe: ok for today's mood 1: if our smallest model were a desk pet, what kind of pet would it be? silly answers only :dog2:

aaron: definite answer: office hamster. hyper, runs on the inference wheel at 3am.

maya: cat. knocks over your prompt then sits on the keyboard until you pet it (i.e., add more context).

zoe: love that. also 'goldfish' for models that forget the conversation every 30s.

aaron: new emoji: :forgetful_goldfish:

build-bot: reminder: keep examples non-identifying and tag as "meme/satire" when sharing.

maya: mini-prompt idea: "You are a helpful goldfish assistant: optimistic, forgetful, gives the same advice twice."

zoe: testing on toybox-mini: "Try again! I think we solved this... wait, did we? Either way, snacks." :laughing:

aaron: can someone make a 3-panel comic? panel1: hamster on wheel labeled 'batching', panel2: cat on keyboard labeled 'poor prompt', panel3: goldfish with sticky note 'I forgot the context but here's a haiku'.

maya: I'm drawing it in the doodle thread. will post when done.

build-bot: doodle posted to #lunchdraw at 12:05.

zoe: brilliant. when it's up I'll add to #lunch-memes and call it 'Model Pets: A Field Guide'.

aaron: cheers to the pets. also reminder: avoid using real names or voice clones in any memes.

maya: noted. also posting my gif of a tiny hamster typing. credit: internet. :hamster:

zoe: perfect endcap. lunch-channel drop at 12:10.
